protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-59. HashiCorp HCSEC-2026-14 and CVE-2026-6959 (CNA state PUBLISHED, not rejected) describe arbitrary host file read/write as the Nomad process user via allocation log named-pipe symlink swap. Source: a task can replace stdout/stderr FIFOs under the shared alloc logs dir (logmon_hook joins logDir with .<task>.stdout.fifo / .<task>.stderr.fifo) or replace the logs directory itself. Sink: host-namespace logmon opens those paths without O_NOFOLLOW (at introduction fifo.New -> containerd OpenFifo O_RDONLY|O_CREAT|O_NONBLOCK; at v2.0.0 os.OpenFile(path, unix.O_RDONLY, os.ModeNamedPipe) in client/lib/fifo/fifo_unix.go). On task restart logmon is recreated, follows the symlink, and copies host file bytes into attacker-readable task logs, or creates FIFOs/logs in an attacker-chosen host directory. Fix 2a09fd62c23880ff306499ae03fe64628d82a23f confines Unix FIFO ops with os.Root/mkfifoat (O_NOFOLLOW) and bind-mounts alloc/logs read-only.
